Package Game_Objects.Entities

Class Amoeba

java.lang.Object
Game_Objects.GameObject
Game_Objects.Entities.Entity
Game_Objects.Entities.Amoeba
public class Amoeba extends Entity
This class represents the Amoeba entity. This class also controls the spreading of an Amoeba, and the behaviour of a group of Amoebae.
Author:
Rhys Evans
